compiler_only_output.reason: include/types.h gives Vector3 a deliberately empty inline destructor, so every TU that destroys a Vector3 re-emits it as vague linkage -- here the Vector3 locals in InitResources (bodyOffset/headOffset), func_ov032_02112044 (v) and func_ov032_021113fc (v1, v2, hv). The cartridge keeps one copy at arm9:0x020072c0, kind:function(arm,size=0x4), and an enrolled source already owns it; rombuild compares this object's body against those cartridge bytes and refuses anything but byte-identical vague-linkage output before discarding the duplicate.

partial_isolation.reason: The final intact TU replaces all 24 legacy shards and lets mwccarm synthesize the ROM-order D1/D0 pair. There is no truthful per-function legacy-object comparison for the synthesized destructors or the newly joined factory; intact whole-object link and data verification is the production proof.
